source.license_note: Real upstream victoria PR #10629; ACBench task derived from its regression test + fix.

task.summary: UnmarshalBytes accepts a poisoned length prefix because its bounds check overflows uint64 and returns a slice past the end of the input.
task.instructions: Fix the defect in the encoding package so the failing regression test passes without modifying any test.
task.acceptance_notes: FAIL_TO_PASS must pass; do not edit *_test.go.

code_fault.description: The length bounds check in UnmarshalBytes computes uint64(nSize)+n which overflows for a large decoded length n, so the check passes and an out-of-bounds slice is returned instead of an error.

ops_fault.description: A crafted varint length prefix bypasses the size validation in UnmarshalBytes and yields an oversized slice, leading to out-of-bounds reads and corrupted decoding.
localization_keywords: decoded length n compared to len(src)
repair_keywords: rewrite bounds check as n > uint64(len(src)-nSize)

visible_context.issue_text: A poisoned varint length prefix passed to UnmarshalBytes is accepted instead of rejected, so the function returns a slice that extends past the end of the source buffer.
error_logs: UnmarshalBytes returned non-empty result for malformed length prefix
decoded byte slice length exceeds remaining input bytes
slice bounds out of range while reading unmarshalled bytes
visible_context.notes: Real upstream regression; diagnosis injected as upstream ops context.
